name: newsgroup-read
description: Read Tradebee news groups with optional exact ID and pagination.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get.

newsgroup_id.description: Optional positive ID for one exact news group. Omit it to list all groups.

fields.description: Optional fields to return. Omit it or send [] for all supported fields.

pagination.description: Optional pagination settings; defaults to current_page=1 and page_size=5.

current_page.description: Page number starting at 1. Follow returned has_next_page and next_page values.

page_size.description: Records per page, from 1-10; defaults to 5.

output.description: API result with pagination and news-group list.
